description: For an infinite regular cardinal k, every member of a transitive set of cardinality below k has membership rank below k.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.HereditaryCardinality.small_transitive_ranks.{u} (θ : Cardinal.{u}) (hθ : θ.IsRegular)
  (T : ZFSet.{u}) (hT : T.IsTransitive) (hsize : T.card < θ) (y : ZFSet.{u}) : y ∈ T → y.rank < θ.ord
